description: Source code implementing ICMPv6 protocol functions, including packet creation, handling echo requests, error reporting, and input processing within the Zephyr RTOS network stack.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_type2str
methods.description: Converts ICMPv6 type code to human-readable string.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_finalize
methods.description: Finalizes ICMPv6 packet by calculating checksum if needed.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_create
methods.description: Creates ICMPv6 header with specified type and code.

methods.name: icmpv6_handle_echo_request
methods.description: Handles incoming ICMPv6 echo request and sends reply.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_send_error
methods.description: Constructs and sends ICMPv6 error message based on original packet.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_input
methods.description: Processes incoming ICMPv6 packets, verifies checksum, and dispatches handlers.

methods.name: net_icmpv6_init
methods.description: Initializes ICMPv6 subsystem and registers echo request handler.
